watch.summary: The streamer reacts with mild disbelief as he observes and imitates an unusually awkward, floating-finger mouse grip.

beats.what: Streamer questions who holds a mouse like that.
Streamer points out and imitates the floating middle finger.
Streamer expresses how uncomfortable it looks and shows pure confusion.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The creator's genuine bewilderment and hand-imitation highlight the visual absurdity of the clip. It relies on universal visual humor without requiring specific gaming context.
